[size=3][b]✨[/b]Huge thanks to[b] [/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/StarAmy/mods?gameId=1303]StarAmy[/url]﻿[b] [/b]for reformatting my DGA mods into Content Patcher.[b]✨[/b][/size]
[/size][/font]
Content pack contains six paintings as well as two colors of fake museum plaque.

- 'Mona Lisa' by Leonardo Da Vinci
- 'Self Portrait' by Vincent van Gogh
- 'Marilyn Diptych' by Andy Warhol
- 'Crying Girl' by Roy Lichtenstein
- 'Le Chat Blanc' by Pierre Bonnard Musée d'Orsay
- 'The Unicorn Rests in a Garden'

The single plaques have two configurations, one high (one tile from ceiling) and one low (two tiles from ceiling.) 

[ These items appear in Robin's shop and the Catalog. ]

Brass lamps in example screenshots are from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19002]Brass Beauties Sconce[/url] mod.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Q:[/b] Is this compatible with SVE?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! This pack was designed and tested in an active SVE game of mine.
